snippet.title: Akatori: Official Animated Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out this slick animated launch trailer for Akatori, the side-scrolling, pixel-art 2D metroidvania/action-platformer in which you wield Mako's staff to explore and battle your way through all the worlds to save them from the Amber Storms. It's out now on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1442520/Akatori

#ign #gaming
